scope: Offline falsification probes. Passing means worth a held-out experiment, never production approval or provider savings.

composition.limitation: Common compact interface initialization cancels. Schemas and request/result envelopes counted. Hand-authored calls; model planning and repeated prompt processing are unknown. Not upstream Trail.

reuse.limitation: A cache hit still delivers all evidence. Do not claim avoided prompt tokens or speedup from this probe.

retrieval.limitation: Frozen output replay, no model. Includes result/recovery envelopes; excludes common interface and discovery. The budget cap itself is not a relevance guarantee.

nextGate: Expand only a promising mechanism to unseen tasks; require independent correctness and complete provider usage before enabling or claiming savings.
